questions.stem: What is the target time per question in Part 5?

fr.rule: Viser moins de 20 secondes par question de Part 5.
why_wrong: B : vous perdrez du temps pour la Part 7.
D : bien trop long, vous manquerez de temps pour la Part 7.

en.rule: Aim for under 20 seconds per Part 5 question.
why_wrong: B: you would lose time for Part 7.
D: far too long, you would run out of time for Part 7.

questions.stem: You see four choices: decide / decision / decisive / decisively. What type of question is this?

fr.rule: Quatre formes du même mot = question de grammaire (nature du mot).
why_wrong: C : les choix sont de la même famille, c'est de la grammaire.
D : il s'agit de la Part 5.

en.rule: Four forms of the same word = grammar question (part of speech).
why_wrong: C: the choices are from the same family: this is grammar.

questions.stem: For a grammar question, what should you mainly look at?
choices: The first word of the sentence only
The last word of the paragraph
The words right before and after the blank

fr.rule: En grammaire, le contexte immédiat du blanc suffit.
why_wrong: B : il n'y a pas de paragraphe.

en.rule: In grammar questions the immediate context of the blank is enough.
why_wrong: C: does not help to choose.

choices: take a decision to the meeting

fr.rule: Make a decision est la collocation standard.

en.rule: Make a decision is the standard collocation.

questions.stem: What should you do if a Part 5 question takes more than 30 seconds?
choices: Keep reading until you are certain

fr.rule: Pas de pénalité : devinez et avancez.
why_wrong: C : chaque question vaut un point.
D : vous perdrez du temps pour la Part 7.

en.rule: There is no penalty: guess and move on.
why_wrong: C: each question is worth a point.
D: you will lose time for Part 7.
